reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Lotion 200ml + 50ml Special Set
reviews.text: I really like this lotion and use it whenever my skin needs an extra boost of hydration. It’s also great for mixing with foundation to add moisture and prevent dry patches from showing under makeup, which my skin is prone to. It’s a high-quality, no-fuss, and very practical all-rounder.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支乳液，皮膚需要額外補水嘅時候就會用佢。混合粉底一齊用都好正，可以增加保濕，預防化妝之後出現乾紋，我皮膚好易有呢個問題。質素高、簡單實用嘅萬能選手。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Lotion 200ml + 50ml Special Set
reviews.text: I have combo acne prone skin that tents to be very dehydrated, this lotion is great for underneath a thicker moisturizer or on its own during mornings/in a humid environment. Overall very simple ingredients that truly work. If you’re looking for a lightweight lotion that hydrates the skin, this is great. I love the addition of macadamia oil in here as well.
reviews.zh: 我係容易生暗瘡嘅混合肌，但又極度缺水。呢支乳液用喺厚身保濕霜下面好正，濕度高啲嘅環境或者朝早單用都得。整體成分簡單但真係work。如果你搵緊一支清爽又有保濕力嘅乳液，呢支啱晒。我亦都好鍾意入面加入咗夏威夷果仁油。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Lotion 200ml + 50ml Special Set
reviews.text: This broke me out and damaged my skin barrier, which was very disappointing because I really liked their toner and sunscreen. I absolutely hate the bottle design. It's kind of hard to get the product out without accidentally squeezing too much out. It is a very lightweight moisturizer though if you're looking for that.
reviews.zh: 呢支用咗令我爆瘡，搞到我皮膚屏障受損，好失望，因為佢哋支爽膚水同防曬我都幾鍾意。樽嘅設計我真係好憎。有時想拎少少產品出嚟都好難，一唔小心就會唧太多。不過如果你想搵一支好清爽嘅保濕，佢係做到嘅。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Lotion 200ml + 50ml Special Set
reviews.text: I started Tretinoin about two months ago and this has been the BEST product to help combat dryness and irritation. I love how hydrating it is, even though it is thicker than the toner, it still melts directly into your skin. I use it after my first essence, the 1025 Toner and before any other serums or tretinoin on the nights I use it. I have been lucky enough to have only slight irritation- and that was only when I used an BHA product- I definitely credit this product as one of the main reasons I have been tolerating it so well. I also have extremely dry skin to start and am age 39- so dryness and well aging are two of my major skincare concerns. I will continue buying this product over and over again! This has virtually replaced the Laneige Cream Skin Refiner- which was a holy grail for the past two years for me!
reviews.zh: 我大概兩個月前開始用 A 醇，呢支絕對係幫我對付乾燥同刺激嘅最強戰友。雖然比爽膚水杰身，但係一搽就好快融入皮膚，保濕力一流。用嘅時候我會喺第一支精華（即 1025 爽膚水）之後搽，之後先用其他精華或者 A 醇（如果嗰晚有用嘅話）。我好彩只係有少少刺激感——而且都係因為我另外用咗 BHA 產品先會——我覺得我用到 A 醇用到咁順，呢支絕對係功臣之一。我本身皮膚極乾，又39歲，所以乾燥同抗老係我兩大護膚煩惱。我會一直回購呢支產品！基本上已經取代咗 Laneige Cream Skin Refiner——嗰支我過去兩年都當佢係神物！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Toner + Lotion 200mL Special Set
reviews.text:
I absolutely love this set. The first time I tried it was in a sample without any expectations. The way it absorbed into the skin and made it feel hydrated, I was in love.
Needless to say, after buying the full size of it, I am still in love. Would highly recommend if you have sensitive and combination dry skin!
reviews.zh:
我非常鍾意呢套產品。第一次試用係sample，完全冇抱任何期望。佢滲入皮膚嘅方式令皮膚feel到好保濕，我就愛上咗。
唔使講，買咗正裝之後，我仲係好愛。敏感肌同混合偏乾嘅皮膚會好推薦！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Toner + Lotion 200mL Special Set
reviews.text:
For both toner & lotion; great everyday baseline products in skincare routine for combo skin. Too much of anything can really mess with my skin’s overall health and these have a great Goldilocks formula. I have felt and seen a lot of my dead skin clear since using these two. It can lead to mild itchiness though if you don’t wash all the dead skin off your face during your next wash. 

Toner: consistency, look, and feel of water. Gives a good gauge of how thirsty my skin is based on how fast or slow my skin absorbs it. Gives me a good idea of the attention my skin needs and what I should add or remove in my next routine steps.

Lotion: I think the consistency is thinner than the usual facial lotion. It’s a runner; squeeze it out of the bottle with care or a lot will come out. Like the toner, it’s a good gauge of my skin’s moisture level. Since it’s thin and light, I can either put more or add cream to finish. This lotion has really helped toned down my oiliness.
reviews.zh:
爽膚水同乳液都係——護膚程序入面好啱混合性肌每日用嘅基礎產品。任何嘢用太多都真係會搞亂皮膚嘅整體健康，但呢兩支嘅formula好「剛剛好」（Goldilocks）。自從用咗呢兩支，我feel到亦都見到死皮清咗好多。不過如果下次洗面冇將死皮徹底洗走，可能會有少少痕。

爽膚水：質地、望落同摸落都好似水。可以根據皮膚吸收嘅快慢，畀到我一個好準嘅指標，知道皮膚有幾渴，畀我清楚知道皮膚需要點樣照顧，下一步程序應該加咗或者減咗咩。

乳液：我覺得質地比一般面乳液稀。佢會自己跑出嚟，所以要小心咁揸出嚟，唔係嘅話會擠太多出嚟。同爽膚水一樣，可以作為皮膚保濕程度嘅指標。質地稀薄輕盈，我可以再搽多層或者加cream收結。呢支乳液真係幫我減咗好多面油。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Toner + Lotion 200mL Special Set
reviews.text: I always use this toner and lotion since forever. This is very light but makes my skin moisturized! Since I started using these, my skin got smoother and better! Friends and family even complimented me in a good way and they started using these too after I told them my secret haha
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊呢支爽膚水同乳液，已經用咗好耐。質地好輕但係皮膚好保濕！自從開始用，我皮膚滑咗、靚咗！朋友同屋企人都讚我，聽完我分享之後佢哋都開始用埋，哈哈。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Lotion 200ml + 50ml Special Set
reviews.text:
I love the ingredients in this lotion and I also love that you get a small 50ml bottle in this set.

This is a lotion and it is very light. I would not use this in the winter or if my skin needed a lot of hydration. This is when a heavier cream comes in. Right now, summer is here and it is warm. This makes me feel hydrated without feeling heavy. It's quite ''watery'' and your skin should drink it right up. I would actually like to see another version that is a bit thicker. Not a cream. I have put on two layers on specific days, depending on the weather. I wish that I saw ceramides in this. I mix it with some Cerave night lotion to get the ceramides. Other than that, it's a pretty perfect lotion. It has amazing ingredients and isn't like every lotion out there. 

Kudos to ROUND LAB on a solid product. I will repurchase!
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意呢支乳液嘅成分，亦都好鍾意呢套入面有支細嘅50ml。

呢支係乳液，質地好輕。冬天或者皮膚需要好強保濕嘅時候我唔會用呢支，呢個時候就要用返厚重啲嘅cream。而家夏天到咗，天氣暖，用呢支皮膚有保濕感又唔會覺得笠。質地幾「水」，皮膚會即刻飲晒。其實我會想見到有再稠少少嘅版本，但唔係cream。視乎天氣，我喺某啲日子會搽兩層。我希望成分入面見到ceramides。我會溝少少Cerave晚霜去補返ceramides。除咗呢樣，呢支乳液真係好完美。成分好勁，唔係出面嗰啲普通乳液。

多謝ROUND LAB做咗支咁實淨嘅產品。我會回購！
